entries.name: Auditory Ninja Tool
entries.text: You gain an Auditory Ninja Tool, a weapon with the Light and Finesse qualities with which you are proficient. This weapon deals either 1d4 bludgeoning damage or Xd4 psychic damage, where X = your level / 4. Attacks that deal psychic damage use your Genjutsu modifier for damage instead of Strength or Dexterity. You may use this tool as a component of any Genjutsu you cast with the Auditory keyword, replacing the Hand Sign (HS) component (if any) and increasing the first instance of damage dealt by +1 damage die.

entries.name: Get Into Position
entries.text: When you would withhold your action to cast a jutsu in response to a hostile or allied creature's actions, you can, as part of the same action, command up to 2 allies to move up to 30 feet into any space that can hold them.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.text: The Kashu Genin may make two attacks with its currently equipped weapons.

entries.name: Auditory Ninja Tool
entries.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 1) bludgeoning or 5 (1d4 + 2) psychic damage.

entries.name: Shuriken
entries.text: Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 1) slashing damage.
